question: Find the length of the longest pole that can be placed in a cubical room of edge 27 cm.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Longest pole inside cube = Space diagonal

Use shortcut: Diagonal = Edge × √3

27 × √3 = 27√3

**∴ The correct answer is 27√3 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Edge of cubical room = 27 cm

**Formula Used:**

Space diagonal of cube = Edge × √3

 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 27 cm Longest Pole 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Longest pole = Space diagonal of cube

⇒ = 27 × √3

⇒ = 27√3 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 27√3 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cube Space Diagonal

Space diagonal of cube = a√3 where a is edge length.

Face Diagonal of Cube

Face diagonal = a√2. It connects opposite corners of one face.

Cuboid Space Diagonal

For cuboid, diagonal = √(l² + b² + h²).
